serverInfo.versionSource: src/adapters/mcp/server.mjs:1,17 metadata.version = package.json "version" (value 2.4.2 at HEAD a44c4d1). The Java server must report its own project version here; the 2.4.2 literal documents the 2.x baseline only. Contract tests must not require version equality.

instructions: Contract 2.0. Start with targets; use stable operationKey and exact target revision. submit accepts work; observe defaults to immediate status. A configured native completion hook automatically observes the same operation after submit/observe; continue independent work without starting another watcher. On the hook body, handle its same operation ID and ACK the exact receipt/claim. Installed/registered, watcher started and wake requested are not receipt evidence. Without native hook support, immediate observe and the packaged background watch remain explicit fallback paths. The packaged portal-files client reads and transmits bytes outside the model and returns a UUID. One remote MCP connection is sufficient; a second local MCP server is optional. The remote server cannot read a path on the caller computer. Do not transcribe large file bytes into model tool arguments. Preserve IDs after uncertainty; never replay unknown outcomes, expose credentials or self-approve. show-* is optional owner UI; private ui-* is not for agents. GUI leases support agent interaction within advertised capabilities.
